title: Voxel Rooftop Greenhouse
tests: Generated with openclaw infer image generate using openai/gpt-image-2; exact PNG output verified before append.
prompt:
Render a rooftop greenhouse maintenance scene as richly detailed voxel graphics: a compact city roof garden built from crisp cube geometry, translucent glass panels, stepped planters of herbs and dwarf citrus, blocky irrigation tubes, tiny fans, water barrels, seedling trays, and a repair cart with square tools. Use a warm late-afternoon sky, strong readable silhouettes, tactile pixel-cube shadows, varied greens, terracotta, clear aqua glass, and small lived-in details. The image is a finished visual example only: no captions, no labels, no prompt-card text, no logos, no watermarks, no cinematic movie scene.

Reusable template: Render [SUBJECT] as a richly detailed [STYLE_OR_MEDIUM] image with tactile format-specific marks, clear subject silhouette, environmental context, and no prompt-card text.

Operation: changes the subject into a finished style/medium showcase where the medium controls geometry, texture, lighting, and surface detail rather than acting like a light filter.

Negative constraints: no readable private data, no logos, no watermarks, no prompt cards, no incoherent anatomy, no generic centered product photo.

Example substitution: Render a neighborhood rooftop greenhouse maintenance scene as richly detailed voxel graphics.

title: Scratchboard Night Kitchen
tests: Generated with openai/gpt-image-2 via OpenClaw CLI; exact source PNG verified under tool-image-generation; appended as random rendering style and converted/uploaded to R2 by append-entry.py.
prompt:
Render a cramped late-night apartment galley kitchen as a richly detailed scratchboard illustration. The scene is built from black ink with carved white linework and a few restrained warm amber and dull teal hand-tinted accents: an open enamel sink with stacked mugs, a checked dish towel, a tiny windowsill herb pot, steam curling from a dented kettle, tiled backsplash cracks, hanging utensils, a loaf of bread under a cloth, a small table fan, magnets on the refrigerator with no readable text, rain streaks on the dark window, and pools of lamplight scraped out of the black surface. Make the scratchboard medium unmistakable: dense cross-hatched cuts, burr-like scraped highlights, stippled metal reflections, white edge glints on ceramic and glass, uneven hand-engraved textures, and strong graphic silhouettes. Finished visual example only, no captions, no labels, no prompt-card text, no logos, no watermarks, no cinematic movie framing, no people.

Reusable template: Render [SUBJECT] as a richly detailed [STYLE_OR_MEDIUM] image with tactile format-specific marks, clear subject silhouette, environmental context, and no prompt-card text.

Operation: changes the subject into a finished style/medium showcase where the medium controls geometry, texture, lighting, and surface detail rather than acting like a light filter.

Negative constraints: no readable private data, no logos, no watermarks, no prompt cards, no incoherent anatomy, no generic centered product photo.

Example substitution: Render a cramped late-night apartment galley kitchen as a richly detailed scratchboard illustration with black ink, carved white linework, amber and dull teal hand-tinted accents, rain-streaked window, enamel sink, steam, utensils, and dense scraped highlights.
